exact_blockers: The pinned asset ledger records baseline.onnx at data/models/dpdfnet/baseline.onnx as 8,722,707 bytes with SHA-256 371d26182aff0e1e0d31354e24c81f79cd57458f5a7dd003fc10a7ebf64255e0, but model_revision is null and the download revision is the mutable 'main' with no retrieval-time commit. The official snapshot 1a80d48e150711322f84cb9d4c91b3520045cf64 lists onnx/baseline.onnx but no file-level digest was available, so these exact bytes are not bound to an immutable artifact revision; the asset is absent from this SDK worktree and no bytes were read.

The streaming runtime is the external dpdfnet 0.6.0 CPU ONNX package and its StreamEnhancer path. It is not installed here, has no pinned wheel/sdist artifact digest in this worktree, and no vendor runtime or ONNX Runtime was invoked. The recorded streaming wrapper processed 160-sample chunks, required final flush, compensated a measured 640-sample lag, and zero-padded a flush tail of up to 158 samples; that is wrapper behaviour, not a verified provider-native zero-lag drain or a v0 callback-safe runtime.

Apache-2.0 is recorded for the package and model card, but artifact-specific weight rights, training-data provenance (DNS4, MLS, DPCRN-processed speech, MUSAN, FSD50K, reverberation), VCTK speaker privacy/publicity, redistribution clearance and legal review are not established; no weight, runtime or upstream source may be vendored, packaged, downloaded or redistributed by this package.

No rights-cleared paired real streaming cohort, independent clean-reference scorer, permitted listening result, target pacing/deadline/latency measurement or approved exact streaming reference output vector for these frozen inputs exists; all eight release gates remain blocked.
